messages:
maria_sd: Quick sync — Gobi Systems wants to start the alpha access for their new accelerator next week. They asked for a telemetry and benchmark handover. Who can own the checklist?
kevin_pm: I can coordinate partner comms and NDA status. Do we have legal sign-off yet? :thinking_face:
maria_sd: Legal sent the NDA draft yesterday. Kevin, can you confirm countersign timeline?
kevin_pm: Looping legal now. Expect countersign by EOD tomorrow if no surprises.
oliver_eng: For benchmarks — are we running our standard token-latency suite or the heavy-inference runbook? Need to know expected seq-lens and model weights.
maria_sd: Gobi asked us to evaluate both latency and sustained throughput with 4k and 8k sequences. Also wants a marketplace-friendly artifact (containers + docs).
frank_sre: We should gate the 8k runs to dedicated infra. I'll provision a sandbox cluster and set quota. Frank -> will need the exact docker image + model tar.
gobi_rep: thanks — gobi here. We'll provide a Q1-8 model tar (float16) and a small sample corpus. We'll also share a hardware firmware build for the test nodes.
kevin_pm: Important: telemetry retention and PII. Partner is okay with aggregated perf metrics, but no request/response payloads can leave their lab. Legal flagged that.
oliver_eng: Understood. We'll enable prefix-only telemetry and token-level timings. No full logs off-box. Config snippet we plan to run: ```
REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_MODE=agg
PREFIX_CAPTURE=true
RAW_PAYLOAD_EXPORT=false
BATCH_SIZE=32
```
frank_sre: I'll add a network ACL so telemetry only goes to our internal ingestion endpoint. We can store aggregated metrics in a partner-scoped bucket with 90-day retention.
maria_sd: Marketplace listing: partner asked about private listing vs public. We should recommend private listing during alpha. Kevin can draft the marketplace blurb + compliance notes.
kevin_pm: Drafted a two-paragraph blurb and a short ops checklist. Will post in #marketing once NDA is signed.
gobi_rep: One ask from Gobi: can Redwood run a short stress run that simulates bursty enterprise traffic? They want to see tail latency under burst.
oliver_eng: We have a burst test harness. Will need 500 concurrent connections, ramp profile, and KV cache warmup plan. Can Gobi provide a launch script or should we synthesize traffic?
gobi_rep: We'll share a script and a small JMeter profile. Expect to deliver by Monday.
frank_sre: Action items so far: 1) Legal countersign (kevin) 2) Sandbox infra (frank) 3) Benchmark harness + config (oliver) 4) Marketplace blurb + docs (kevin) 5) Partner artifacts (gobi)
maria_sd: Agree. Also: schedule a kickoff demo on Tue 10am PT. Kevin, can you book a 45m slot with Gobi and engineering?
kevin_pm: Booking now. Invites in 5.
telemetry-bot: Reminder set — kickoff demo Tue 10:00 PT. :calendar: 
kevin_pm: One more note — for the final report we need: latency p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, and a small summary of deviation from baseline. Keep it concise (1 page).
oliver_eng: Got it. We'll produce the report and include a raw aggregated CSV for internal troubleshooting only.
maria_sd: Thanks all. If anything blocks legal or infra ping me directly.
kevin_pm: thumbs up :thumbsup:
